If opponent's just lost character is about to be removed from Lost Pile, may lose 1 Force to capture (imprison or let escape) that character instead. (Immune to Alter.)

title: The Emperor
lore: Leader. Secretive manipulator of the galaxy. Played Darth Vader and Prince Xizor off against one another in his relentless pursuit of 'young Skywalker'.
gameText: Never deploys or moves (even if carried) to a non-Senate site opponent occupies. Each turn, may lose 1 Force (free in battle) to target a character present with him. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny +1 > defense value. Gains [Republic] at opponent's Senate.

title: The Emperor's Prize
lore: Vader thought that by capturing Luke, he would crush the Alliance's last hope. But, there was another...
gameText: Unless your [Death Star II] Objective on table, deploy on Vader. Target Luke (even at Dagobah). During opponent's move phase, if Vader present at a battleground site, opponent loses 1 Force. Utinni Effect canceled when reached by target.

title: Vader's Bounty
lore: 'We would be honored if you would join us.'
gameText: Deploy on table. During battle, while non-[Reflections 3] Boba Fett with Vader, neither may be excluded or lost until the damage segment. Slave I is destiny +2 when drawn for weapon or battle destiny. May place this Effect in Lost Pile to make Boba Fett's total weapon destiny +3.

title: Weather Vane
lore: Not a good place to hang around.
gameText: Deploy on table. Character here lost if new character arrives. Your Force generation is +2 while Bespin: Cloud City on table. During owner's control phase, they must relocate character here to a Cloud City site (if a bounty hunter on Cloud City, character captured instead). (Immune to Alter.)

title: We're The Bait
lore: 'He doesn't want you at all, he's after somebody called, uh...Skywalker.' 'Luke?' 'Lord Vader has set a trap for him.' 'And we're that bait!' 'Yeah, well, he's on his way.'
gameText: Deploy on table. It's A Trap! may not be played. Once per game, may use 1 Force to deploy an Effect with 'Bespin' or 'Cloud City' in lore or game text from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If Chewie, Han, Leia, or Luke wins a battle on Cloud City, place this Effect in Used Pile.

title: Bane Malar
lore: Mysterious bounty hunter of an unknown species. Rumored to be somewhat telepathic. Infrequent member of Jabba's court. Plotting to kill Jabba.
gameText: Blaster Rifle is a matching weapon for Bane. While at a battleground planet site, your Force drains and Force drain bonuses here and at same site as Ree-Yees may not be canceled. Immune to attrition < 3.

title: Brief Loss Of Control
lore: Eliciting fear from the opponent gives the dark side a powerful advantage.
gameText: USED: Once per game, during opponent's activate phase, target a location. Opponent is prevented from controlling that location (and loses senate majority if targeting Galactic Senate) for remainder of turn. LOST: Cancel Control.

title: Flagship Operations
lore: 'There's too many of them!'
gameText: Deploy on a system. Your TIEs may relocate (as a regular move) to a system from 0 to 3 parsecs away. For each battleground system you control with two TIEs piloted by Imperials, you may add 3 to your total power in battles. Opponent's Force drain is +3 here. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Frustration
lore: 'Rrraaaarrr!'
gameText: USED: If you just peeked at cards in your Life Force, peek at and reorder the top 3 cards of that deck or pile (may take one into hand). LOST: If Xizor and Guri are in a battle together, your total battle destiny is +5 and may retrieve 1 Force.

title: Guri
lore: Human-replica droid. Programmed to function as Xizor's personal bodyguard and assassin. Black Sun agent. Cost 9 million credits. Worth every decicred.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. At Coruscant sites where you have a Black Sun Agent, your Force drains are +1. While with Xizor in battle, she may be forfeited to satisfy all remaining battle damage against you. Immune to Restraining Bolt, purchase, and attrition < 5.

title: Information Exchange
lore: Chisa nyooda ishaley. Kun Jabba neguda len malta. Ikkit ui! Yobbit, yobbit. Nelan tui ke bada.
gameText: Deploy on Imperial City. While your [Reflections II] Objective on table, Scum And Villainy may deploy here and, if a Black Sun agent present, may not be canceled. During your deploy phase, may ▼ a non-weapon card with 'Black Sun' or 'Xizor' in lore.

title: Prince Xizor
lore: Falleen gangster and leader. Black Sun agent. Dark Prince of the Black Sun crime syndicate. Fortifies his personal defenses with information gathered by his agents.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Other Black Sun agents are forfeit +1. Your unique (•) gamblers, gangsters, smugglers, and thieves are Black Sun agents. Once per turn, may ▲ Unexpected Interruption. Immune to attrition < 4.

title: Slave I
lore: Originally designed as a planetary defense craft. Uses restricted jamming technology, allowing it to appear out of nowhere. Contains many hidden armaments.
gameText: May add 1 alien pilot and 3 passengers. May deploy with non-[Maintenance] Boba Fett as a react (for free). While Boba Fett piloting, maneuver +2, power may not be reduced, and immune to attrition < 5.

title: Those Rebels Won't Escape Us
lore: 'I don't know how we're gonna get out of this one.'
gameText: Use 1 Force to ▲ Stinger or Virago. OR Cancel Darklighter Spin. OR If opponent just initiated a battle at same system or sector as Stinger or Virago, opponent may not target those starfighters with weapons for remainder of turn.

title: Unexpected Interruption
lore: 'Sir! Sir! I've isolated the reverse power flux coupling!'
gameText: If a battle was just initiated, target an opponent's female non-droid character present with Xizor. Draw destiny. Target excluded from battle and adds her power to Xizor's for remainder of turn if destiny +2 > target's ability.

title: Zuckuss
lore: Male Gand. Practitioner of ancient religious findsman vocation. Bounty hunter and scout. Gains surprisingly accurate information through mystical visions during meditation.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Mist Hunter is maneuver +1. Your Black Sun agents at same and related sites may not have their forfeit reduced. Once per game, may deploy non-lightsaber 4-LOM here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 3.

title: All Wrapped Up
lore: A capture cable is a quick and effective way for bounty hunters to suddenly snare their target.
gameText: Deploy on table. Double Back is a Used Interrupt. Once per turn, may take Bounty into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If present, your bounty hunter may capture a character opponent just forfeited at same site. Whenever you collect a bounty, may place that Effect out of play to take a retrieved card into hand. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Bantha Herd
lore: While banthas are found on many worlds, the largest herds are found on Tatooine. The Sand People of that planet learned to tame the beasts.
gameText: Deploy on a Tatooine site. Once per turn, may place up to 3 cards from hand face down here. You may 'react' to battles initiated against your lone Tusken Raider by deploying (for free) any Tusken Raider(s) and/or Bantha(s) here. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Boba Fett
lore: Infamous bounty hunter. Hired to help Jabba intimidate debtors and smugglers. Crack shot. Mandalorian armor and jet pack provide protection and flight capability.
gameText: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. 4: Slave I. May 'fly' (landspeed = 3). During battle, may target an opponent's character present with Boba Fett. Draw destiny. Target captured if destiny +2 > ability. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 while with Han or Jabba).

title: Cane Adiss
lore: Adventurous pilot. Boasts to Jabba that he has traveled to every uncharted planet in the galaxy. Has been hired by the Empire to keep an eye out for Rebel activity.
gameText: If opponent just Force drained at a non-battleground location (or at any location for more than 3 Force), deploy on that location. To initiate a Force drain at same or related location, opponent must first place a card from hand in Lost Pile. (Immune to Control.)

title: Combat Readiness
lore: Imperial troops remain prepared for quick deployment to seize valuable terrain.
gameText: STARTING: If your starting location was a battleground site, [download] up to two related locations (one must be a system) with < 4 total [Dark Side Force] and up to three Effects that are always [Immune to Alter]. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.

title: Den Of Thieves
lore: Jabba's palace is considered a safe haven to many on the run. It is also widely known to provide luxurious accommodations to its welcomed guests.
gameText: Deploy on table. Your aliens of ability < 3 may not have their forfeit values reduced (except by Molator). Your battle destiny draws are +1 where you have a character with "plotting to kill Jabba" in lore. May lose 1 Force to raise your converted [Jabba's Palace] site to the top.

title: Drop!
lore: Anakin had to heed Qui-Gon's advice to avoid the rapidly approaching storm.
gameText: Deploy on table with 12 Defensive Shields from outside your deck face-down under here. Four times per game may play a card from here (as if from hand). Unless Thrown Back (V) on table, each player's [upload] or [download] attempt (after the first in a turn) allows their opponent to draw top card from Reserve deck and/or activate 1 Force.

title: Fozec
lore: Spy for the Empire. Keeping tabs on Jabba's activities for the ISB. Secretly hoping to leave the Empire and pursue lucrative opportunities in the underworld.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While Undercover, opponent's Force drains at related locations are -1. Once during battle, if with an ISB agent, may cause opponent to draw destiny. You may retrieve 2 Force if destiny > 2.

title: Gela Yeens
lore: Bad-tempered smuggler. Makes a few credits more helping Jabba collect debts. Highly regarded for his uncanny anticipation in battle. Searching for Debnoli.
gameText: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Opponent may not target Gela Yeens (or a starship he pilots) with weapons. While in battle with Jabba, opponent's characters at same site are power and forfeit -2.

title: Hermi Odle
lore: Baragwin assigned by Jabba to be the palace's master weaponsmith. Enemy of Pote Snitkin.
gameText: Characters at same and related sites may not have their weapons stolen or be targeted to be Disarmed. Your non-lightsaber, non-[Permanent Weapon] character weapon destiny draws are +2.

title: Hutt Bounty
lore: 'Chissaa, picha gawanki Chewbacca. Yupon cogorato kama walpa kyess kashung kawa Wookiee.'
gameText: Deploy on Jabba. Your battle destiny draws are +1. At related sites you control, your Force generation is +1. During battle here, may make a non-Jedi character present with Jabba power = 0.

title: Jabba The Hutt
lore: Jabba Desilijic Tiure. Male heir to Zorba the Hutt. Gangster. Leader of one of the largest criminal organizations in the galaxy. Over six hundred years old.
gameText: While with your alien leader, Jabba is immune to attrition and may not be targeted by Interrupts or weapons. May [download] one Scum And Villainy. During battle, may use 1 Force to double the power of one other non-[Maintenance] alien present.

title: Jabba's Sail Barge
lore: Ubrikkian sail barge. Custom built for Jabba with an armored hull and weaponry. Top speed of 100 kph. Used by the Hutt crimelord on his many trips to Mos Eisley.
gameText: Deploys only on Tatooine. May add 1 driver and 8 passengers. Scum And Villainy may deploy aboard. During your deploy phase, may [download] one Jabba, Pote, or Passenger Deck aboard. Immune to attrition < 6.

title: Jabba's Space Cruiser
lore: Flying fortress of Jabba Desilijic Tiure. Reaches speeds of 800 kph in atmosphere. The crime lord installed hidden gunports as an unpleasant surprise for would-be pirates.
gameText: May add 2 alien pilots and 6 passengers. May deploy an [Independent] starship (with a pilot aboard, if unpiloted) here from hand and/or Reserve Deck (for free) as a 'react'; reshuffle. If Jabba here, immune to attrition.

title: J'Quille
lore: Whiphid spy in league with Lady Valarian. Yearns for battle. Enjoys hearing the screams of his victims. Plotting to kill Jabba.
gameText: May deploy to a shielded site, and, for remainder of that turn, suspends 'Hoth Energy Shield Rules' at his site. Once per game, when deployed to a site, opponent loses 1 Force for each Light Side character present.

title: Malakili
lore: Corellian. Worked for Circus Horrificus. Disapproves of Jabba's treatment of the rancor. Plotting with Lady Valarian to steal the immense beast away from Jabba's palace.
gameText: Deploys -4 on Tatooine. Rancors may deploy here (even if Malakili is not the only character, habitat permitting), are defense value +4 here, and may not attack Malakili. During your deploy phase, may deploy one Rancor here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Nizuc Bek
lore: Guard from Corulag. Former bouncer at the Mos Eisley cantina. Assigned by Jabba to guard celebrities visiting Jabba's palace. Friend of Wuher. Loves juri juice.
gameText: Whenever opponent Force drains at a non-battleground, may retrieve 1 Force. During your deploy phase, may deploy an Effect with 'matching' in game text from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per turn, may place Juri Juice from hand on Force Pile to cancel a Force drain.

title: None Shall Pass
lore: Jabba's Gamorrean guards keep a watchful eye for unwelcome guests.
gameText: If opponent just deployed a character (except Leia) to a Jabba's Palace site, use 1 Force to place that character on bottom of opponent's Force Pile (opponent may draw two cards from Reserve Deck).

title: Sacrifice
lore: Jabba's minions could be expected to be sacrificed to save the Hutt, to destroy one of the Hutts enemies or to provide the Hutt and his minions with a good laugh.
gameText: If opponent just initiated a battle, target your non-immune to Alter Effect on table. Draw destiny. Place target on Used Pile and activate up to X Force if destiny < X, where X = target's destiny number.

title: Twi'lek Advisor
lore: 'He's no Jedi.'
gameText: USED: Use 3 Force to deploy a unique (•) alien (for free) from hand or Used Pile; reshuffle. STARTING: Take into hand and/or deploy from Reserve Deck up to three Effects of any kind with 'Jabba' in lore or game text. Place this Interrupt in Reserve Deck.

title: URoRRuR'R'R
lore: Leader of a Tusken Raider tribe. Unafraid of machines. Skilled hunter and marksman. Raids moisture farms for water. Roams the Jundland Wastes in search of unwary travelers.
gameText: Deploys only on Tatooine. While with another Tusken Raider: opponent's weapon destiny draws here are -2; once per turn, may place a card from hand on Force Pile to draw top card of Reserve Deck; and other Tusken Raiders here are forfeit +4.

title: URoRRuR'R'R's Bantha
lore: Raised by RR'uruurr for personal use by URoRRuR'R'R. Alpha male of his bantha herd. Has trampled many Jawas. Nicknamed 'Rrr'ur'R.
gameText: Deploys only on Tatooine. May add 2 'riders' (passengers). Ability = 1/2. While URoRRuR'R'R aboard, adds one battle destiny. During your deploy phase, may deploy one URoRRuR'R'R here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Ur'Ru'r
lore: Fierce Tusken Raider. Ransacks homes and moisture farms on the borders of Mos Espa.
gameText: Deploys only on Tatooine. During your deploy phase, if with URoRRuR'R'R, may deploy a weapon with 'Tusken' in lore here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle; your weapon destiny draws for such weapons are +2. During your deploy phase, may move Ur'Ru'r as a regular move.

title: Vizam
lore: Kajain'sa'Nikto. Keeps Jabba's vehicles and starships well armed. Has hidden several weapon caches on board Jabba's sail barge.
gameText: Whenever opponent deploys a starship, vehicle, or weapon (including a [Permanent Weapon] weapon) to same or related location, you may activate 2 Force.

title: Wooof
lore: Kadas'sa'Nikto. One of Jabba's best pilots. Often pilots Jabba's space yacht. Smuggler. Prefers to be flying combat starfighters.
gameText: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Wooof may deploy with any cruiser using Combat Response. When deployed, may draw top card from Reserve Deck. During your deploy phase, if piloting Jabba's Space Cruiser, may deploy one Jabba aboard (for free) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: A Bright Center To The Universe

titleComponents.name: A Bright Center To The Universe

lore: The intimidating power of the Empire was focused in the core systems, allowing the Emperor to ignore minor activities occurring on the Outer Rim.
gameText: Deploy on table. Once per turn, if you control more battlegrounds than opponent, when you lose Force to a Force drain, may retrieve X Force (may not be canceled), where X = all bonuses to that Force drain.

title: Aratech Corporation
lore: Aratech Corporation sent support staff to various Imperial outposts and garrisons. Gave advanced briefings and training to biker scout personnel.
gameText: Deploy on table. AT-STs and speeder bikes are power and forfeit +1. During your deploy phase, may reveal an AT-ST or Speeder Bike from hand to take a unique (•) Imperial pilot of ability < 3 (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously. (Immune to Alter.)

title: AT-ST Dual Cannon
lore: High rate of fire used for anti-personnel operations. Enhanced design from prototype used in the Battle of Hoth.
gameText: Deploy on your AT-ST. May target a character, creature or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. Target hit (may lose 2 Force to make it lost instead) if destiny +X > defense value, where X = the number of your AT-STs present. May fire repeatedly for 2 Force each time.

title: Commander Igar
lore: Leader. Served with General Veers' Blizzard unit at Battle of Hoth. Assigned by Vader to coordinate surface defense of Endor's moon. Kuat native.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots, 3 to power of any combat vehicle. Once per turn, if piloting a combat vehicle, may use 1 Force to cancel a 'react' from a related site to this site or cancel an opponent's just drawn battle destiny at same site (except their first this battle).

title: Crossfire
lore: Scout walker pilots are trained to set up a deadly heavy fire zone. This tactic can be disrupted by enemy weapons fire.
gameText: Deploy on table. Your AT-STs are immune to attrition < 3 (or their immunity to attrition is +2). Once per game, may lose 1 Force to take an Effect that deploys on a location (except Expand The Empire) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May place this Effect out of play to add one battle destiny. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Dead Ewok
lore: Many Ewoks gave their lives in the Battle of Endor.
gameText: Cancel Ellors Madak. (Immune to Sense.) OR Use 2 Force to cancel the game text of an opponent's alien for remainder of turn. OR Place an Ewok Catapult in opponent's Used Pile. OR Make an Ewok power and forfeit = 0 for remainder of turn.

title: Dreaded Imperial Starfleet
lore: The Empire uses short-range fighters and patrol craft to maintain a presence in every system within its scope of power.
gameText: Deploy on table. While you have more systems on table than opponent, your capital starships deploy -2 (to a minimum of 3) to battlegrounds. When you deploy an Imperial-Class Star Destroyer, may deploy (for free) a [Death Star II] or [A New Hope] squadron there (no replacement is necessary) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Empire's New Order
lore: Palpatine's cruel vision of his Empire included the enslavement and subjugation of entire species.
gameText: Deploy on table. Whenever an opponent's alien is just lost, they lose 1 Force. While all of your ability on table is provided by Imperials and Imperial starship pilots, your admirals, generals, moffs, and Emperor are deploy -1 and are forfeit +1. Aliens are deploy +1 and forfeit -1.

title: Establish Secret Base
lore: The Empire's remote bases develop new technology and hide sensitive projects from potential Rebel saboteurs.
gameText: If you control Bunker, deploy on Endor system. At each Endor site you control with an AT-ST or Biker Scout, opponent's Force generation is canceled. During your deploy phase, may deploy one Aratech Corporation or an Effect with 'Endor' in the lore or game text from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Feltipern Trevagg's Stun Rifle
lore: Assault rifle modified by Feltipern. Used by the Gotal bounty hunter before he became a tax collector. Occasionally brought along to 'ease' Feltipern's collection duties.
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy on your bounty hunter (free on Feltipern Trevagg). May target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target captured (and you may take one Interrupt from Lost Pile into hand) if destiny +2 > defense value.

title: Freeze!
lore: Despite Wicket's warnings, an Imperial scout got the drop on Leia.
gameText: Deploy Blaster Rack from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During battle, attrition against opponent is +1 for each non-lightsaber weapon you have present. OR Your scout is power +3 for remainder of turn.

title: Imperial Academy Training
lore: Graduates of the Empire's military academies train to fire standardissue weapons efficiently.
gameText: Deploy on table. Imperials armed with a blaster or rifle at battleground sites are forfeit +2 and their weapon destiny draws are +1. Once per battle, if you have a non-lightsaber weapon there, may use 2 Force to add 4 to your total power. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Imperial Tyranny
lore: The Empire considers alien species to be inferior.
gameText: USED: Deploy Empire's New Order on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If Vader just won a battle at the same site as an alien, place that alien out of play. LOST: If a battle was just initiated where you have a character weapon card, place the top card of your Lost Pile on top of your Reserve Deck.

title: Inconsequential Losses
lore: With its superior numbers, the Empire knowingly sacrifices the safety of many units and weapons in order to preserve the greater war machine.
gameText: Deploy on table. You may forfeit non-lightsaber weapons (using forfeit value = 3); place your just forfeited weapon in Used Pile. During your deploy phase, if you just deployed a vehicle or starship, may deploy a weapon (for free) on that vehicle or starship from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Lieutenant Grond
lore: Colonel Dyer's aide. Coordinates scout actions. As a youth, raced swoops on homeworld of Corellia. Formerly served with Emperor's Demonstration Team.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Adds one battle destiny if with Colonel Dyer or if driving a swoop. May place Lieutenant Grond in Used Pile to cancel a Force drain at a related location.

title: Lieutenant Renz
lore: Leader of one of the Emperor's finest legions of troops. His command was placed at the disposal of Colonel Dyer. Always on the lookout for Rebel activity.
gameText: Once per game, if at a battleground site, may initiate a Force drain that cannot be canceled; Force drain is +X (this bonus may not be canceled; ignore other modifiers) where X = the number of unique (•) Stormtroopers at battleground sites.

title: Lieutenant Watts
lore: Native of Corulag. Watts' gunnery skills produce devastating results. Temporarily assigned to Kuat Drive Yards to work on prototype AT-ST weaponry.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per turn, if at a battleground site, may take a weapon from Lost Pile into hand to cancel a Force drain at a related site.

title: Major Hewex
lore: Leader of Navy detachment assigned to guard the Endor control bunker. Liaison between Imperial technicians and command staff.
gameText: Your unique (•) Stormtroopers are deploy -1 to same site and are forfeit +1 at same and related locations.

title: Outflank
lore: Commander Igar's defense of Endor called for the use of speeder bikes to harass any attacking Rebels.
gameText: If opponent just initiated battle at a site where their total power is greater than yours, you may use 1 Force (or cause opponent to use 1 Force) to relocate one of your characters or vehicles to that site from a related location.

title: Pinned Down
lore: Heavy blaster fire hampered Han's attempts to open the Back Door to the Endor control bunker.
gameText: Deploy on table. X = 4 on [Virtual Set 8] Tusken Breath Mask. May place this Effect in your Used Pile to cancel a 'react'.

title: Scout Recon
lore: Familiarity with native terrain is essential to a scout garrison. Imperial command can also put this type of information to effective use.
gameText: Find one of your missing characters. OR if your scout is in a battle, activate X Force, where X = the number of scouts you have in that battle. OR add 3 to your total battle destiny during a battle at a site where you have an Imperial and opponent has an alien.

title: Sergeant Wallen
lore: Stormtrooper assigned to Colonel Dyer's command. His unit was recommended to Commander Igar by Governor Yount of the Wakeelmui garrison.
gameText: During battle here, your Imperial leaders may not be targeted by weapons. Your Imperials of ability < 4 at same site (except Galactic Senate) may not have their game text canceled or their forfeit value modified or reset.

title: Sneak Attack
lore: Imperial training allows scouts to use speed and stealth to their advantage. On Endor, they were also backed up by Commander Igar's ATSTs.
gameText: USED: If opponent just initiated a battle, place a card from hand on top of Reserve Deck. LOST: Add one battle destiny where you have an AT-ST, scout, or lone Imperial of ability < 4.

title: Well-earned Command
lore: Imperial officers often simulate large-scale battles with hologram games to improve their tactical ability. Those who excel at these games often mark themselves for advancement.
gameText: Deploy on a battleground site. At sites where you have a vehicle with armor and an Imperial general (or Imperial commander), your total battle destiny is +3 and opponent may not draw more than two battle destiny. If opponent controls this site, this Effect lost.

title: Wipe Them Out, All Of Them

titleComponents.name: Wipe Them Out, All Of Them

lore: Darth Sidious' command was merciless and direct. He left no room for misinterpretation.
gameText: Deploy on a site. Unless a player controls a battleground site, that player's Permanent Weapon weapon destiny draws are -2. During opponent's draw phase, if opponent's non-battleground site (with no related locations) on table, may activate or retrieve 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand
lore: Spy. Ordered to kill Luke Skywalker. Assumed the identity of a dancer named 'Arica' in order to sneak into Jabba's Palace.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. Power +2 if Emperor on table. May be targeted by Vader's Obsession and Epic Duel instead of Vader. Once per game, may deploy a weapon on her from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4.

title: Mara Jade's Lightsaber
lore: As part of her training to become the Emperor's hand, Mara Jade learned from Palpatine himself how to effectively fight with a lightsaber.
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy on Mara Jade. May add 1 to Force Drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.

title: Zuckuss In Mist Hunter
lore: Zuckuss is a dangerous adversary, especially when aboard his own starship. Mystical omens enable the Gand to predict enemy maneuvers in starship combat.
gameText: May add 1 pilot and 3 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Zuckuss, who provides ability of 4 and adds 2 to power. Unless opponent has ability > 6 piloting here, reset opponent's total battle destiny here to 0.

title: Bossk With Mortar Gun
lore: Trandoshan bounty hunter. Modified his mortar gun to fire stun cartridges for live captures. Uses non-fragmentary capture rounds to minimize collateral damage.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Permanent weapon is •Bossk's Mortar Gun (may fire for free; draw destiny; may subtract or add 1 if at same site as a bounty; choose one character with that destiny number present to be captured.)

title: Court Of The Vile Gangster
gameText: Deploy Audience Chamber, Great Pit Of Carkoon and Dungeon. While this side up, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one docking bay or [Independent Starship] starship from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Bounty Hunters are forfeit +2 and immune to Goo Nee Tay. You may not play Scanning Crew. Each player loses 1 Force at end of each of their deploy phases unless that player has a non-droid character at a Tatooine battleground site. Flip this card if you have two captives (or a captive of ability > 2) at any Jabba's Palace site(s).

title: I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die

titleComponents.name: I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die

gameText: While this side up, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy Sarlacc, Rancor or Rancor Pit from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Captives targeted by trap door are immediately relocated to Rancor Pit (do not draw destiny) and Trap Door may not be canceled. Opponent loses Force equal to forfeit value of each opponent's character eaten by a Rancor or Sarlacc (place that character out of play). Flip this card if you have no captives at Tatooine sites and opponent has no character at same site as Rancor.

title: Dengar With Blaster Carbine
lore: Corellian bounty hunter. Skilled athlete. Expert shot. Has worked many times for Jabba the Hutt. Carries a long-standing grudge against Han Solo.
gameText: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Permanent weapon is •Dengar's Blaster Carbine (may target a character, creature or vehicle for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value; may be fired twice per battle).

title: IG-88 In IG-2000
lore: Starship adapted to the assassin droid's specifications. Flight controls linked directly to processing unit. Real-time relays minimize response time.
gameText: May add 2 passengers. Permanent pilot is •IG-88, who adds 2 to power and 3 to maneuver. May initiate battle. When in a battle you initiate, adds one battle destiny. Ion Cannon may deploy aboard.

title: Jodo Kast
lore: Bounty Hunter and scout. Perfectionist. Equipped with mandalorian armor and a jet pack. He doesn't mind being mistaken for Boba Fett. Occasionally works for Black Sun.
gameText: When in battle, if opponent draws more than one battle destiny, may cancel one. Once per turn, when firing a rifle or blaster, may target for free and add 2 to total weapon destiny. May be targeted by Hidden Weapons. May 'fly' (landspeed = 3).

title: Insignificant Rebellion
lore: 'Your fleet is lost. And your friends on the Endor moon will not survive. There is no escape, my young apprentice.'
gameText: If Ralltiir Operations on table, deploy on table. Ounee Ta is canceled. Your troopers are power = 2. Whenever you deploy a site to Ralltiir, may activate 3 Force. Whenever you draw battle destiny, may exchange a card from hand with a card of the same card type in Lost Pile. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Shocking Revelation
lore: 'Well, don't blame me. I'm an interpreter. I'm not supposed to know a power socket from a computer terminal.'
gameText: Unless you have a senate majority, if opponent just took into hand or deployed character (except with an Effect with 'matching' in game text) from Reserve Deck or just drew a card from Reserve Deck using a character's game text, they must place 2 other cards from hand on Used Pile (if possible).

title: Vader
lore: Sought to extinguish all Jedi. Former student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Seduced by the dark side of the Force.
gameText: Adds 4 to power of anything he pilots. Jedi are defense value -1 and forfeit -2 at same and related sites. During battle, if you are about to draw a card for weapon or battle destiny, may instead use an Interrupt of destiny < 4 from hand. Immune to attrition < 5.

title: Vader's Anger
lore: Anger and aggression fuel the dark side of the Force.
gameText: Target a Jedi present with Vader. Initiate an epic duel between them. Both players draw two destiny and add power. Loser (lowest total) is placed out of play and losing player loses 5 Force. OR If Vader just hit a Jedi, retrieve any three cards.

title: Veers
lore: General of the AT-AT assault armor division sent by Darth Vader to crush the Rebellion on Hoth. Cold and ruthless.
gameText: Adds 4 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -2 to Hoth. Your combat vehicles are defense value +1 at same and related locations. While on Hoth, your AT-ATs and Imperials are deploy -1 and forfeit +1 at related locations.

title: Darth Vader's Lightsaber
lore: Vader's lightsaber. Symbol of the most feared man in the galaxy. Vader's control of the dark side of the Force allows him to wield this weapon in surprising ways.
gameText: Deploy on Vader. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a Jedi or Skywalker for free. Draw 3 destiny and choose 2. Target hit (may place any Interrupt from opponent's Lost Pile out of play) and forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.

title: Imperial Justice
lore: 'There's nothing you could have done Luke, had you been there. You'd have been killed too.'
gameText: Deploy on table; shuffle your Reserve Deck, peek at top three cards, and stack them face-up here. During battle, may take a card here into hand to prevent all battle destiny draws from being modified or canceled (each player may draw no more than one battle destiny). (Immune to Alter.)

title: Cold Feet
lore: Wampas pack snow around the appendages of captured prey, making use of Hoth's cold environment to immobilize them.
gameText: Take a 'grabber' into hand (or play a Defensive Shield) from under your Starting Effect. OR Cancel It Can Wait, Surprise Assault, or Yerka Mig. OR Suspend Bacta Tank ('patient' remains on Effect), Bo Shuda, Goo Nee Tay, or No Questions Asked for remainder of turn.

title: Deep Hatred
gameText: Unless your [Reflections III] Objective on table, deploy on table. Vader's Obsession may be played to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Mara is present with Luke, each player draws two destiny (if armed with a lightsaber, each destiny is +1). Add character's ability. If Karrde on table, your total is -1. Higher total wins. If Luke loses, place him out of play and you may retrieve 5 Force. If Mara loses, cross her to the Light Side (she is now Mara Skywalker). Unless duel canceled or tied, for remainder of game any Mara is ability = 6, adds one battle destiny, and once per battle involving her, may cancel one just drawn destiny.

title: Emperor's Power
lore: From his throne room aboard the second Death Star, Emperor Palpatine monitors activity throughout the galaxy.
gameText: Deploy on Emperor. Jedi are power -1 and deploy +1. During opponent's move phase, if Emperor present with Vader (or with two Imperial Council Members at Conference Room or any Throne Room), opponent loses 1 Force.

title: Endor Shield
lore: Planetary scale shield projected from surface of Endor moon. Protected second Death Star during construction. Only another superlaser could penetrate it while operational.
gameText: Deploy on table. Unless Rebel Strike Team on table, opponent generates no Force at Endor system. Twice per game, may take an admiral, commander, general, or moff into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Whenever opponent's Endor on table, raise your converted Endor system to the top (if possible). (Immune to Alter.)

title: Establish Control
lore: Keeping supply routes clear allows rapid distribution of resources to where they are most required.
gameText: Deploy on table. Your Force generation is +2 at docking bays you control. Your docking bays controlled by opponent are battlegrounds. Once per game, may deploy Corulag or Fondor from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If Mobilization Points on table, this Effect lost. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Forced Landing
lore: 'You will not deviate from your present course. . . Permission granted to land on platform three-two-seven.'
gameText: Deploy on table. After starting hands are drawn, players may only take into hand or deploy on table from Reserve Deck (except as a 'react' or response) during their deploy phase (if another phase specified, it becomes 'during your deploy phase'). (Immune to Alter.)

title: Frozen Dinner
lore: Freeze dried and ready to serve, a tasty, wholesome Rebel makes a nutritious meal for the whole wampa clan. They're Gr-r-reat!
gameText: Plays on table. Colo Claw Fish is canceled. Tawss Khaa affects Force drains only at her site. Once per game, may ▲ Pinned Down. While Ellorrs Madak (V) on table: limit one copy on table, each "2" in its game text is treated as "1", and opponent may retrieve Force only once per turn.

title: He Is Not Ready
lore: "All his life has he looked away. To the future; to the horizon. Never his mind on where he was! Hmm? What he was doing! Hm."
gameText: Deploy on table. Just after opponent draws a starting hand of 8 cards, unless you started an Objective and/or you take into hand or deploy from Reserve Deck any other Effects, opponent must place all but 5 cards from hand in their Used Pile; re-circulate. (Immune to Alter.)

title: I Want That Ship
lore: Like nerf herders herding nerfs, Imperial commanders often use TIE fighters to drive fleeing Rebel ships into tractor beam range.
gameText: Deploy on your battleground. During battle, whenever opponent's card is hit by a non-[Permanent Weapon] (once per card targeted), opponent's total power is cumulatively -4 (-2 if hit by a lightsaber).

title: I've Lost Artoo!
lore: "WHAAAAAAAAAOOOOW!"
gameText: Use 2 Force to deploy on table. Once per game, may use 1 Force to play an Interrupt (except Sense, Alter, or Control) from under your Starting Effect as if from hand (then place that card out of play). May place this Effect in Lost Pile to activate 1 Force.

title: Lord Vader
lore: Forgiving administrator of Imperial policy. Emperor Palpatine's most trusted leader. Believes converting Skywalker is key to the Alliance's downfall.
gameText: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. May deploy a lightsaber just lost from same site on him (for free); may then use two weapons. Using Epic Duel, The Circle Is Now Complete may target any Jedi instead of Obi-Wan. Defense value +2 if armed. Immune to attrition < 5.

title: Luke? Luuuuke!
lore: 'All right. I'll be right there, Aunt Beru.'
gameText: Deploy on your non-droid character present at a battleground site; character may not be carried from here or move. Target a Jedi at a site. You lose no more than 1 Force to Force drains at target's location. This Utinni Effect canceled when reached by target.

title: Restricted Access
lore: In an effort to direct Luke toward Vader, Lieutenant Bewil used his control of hatchways and lift tubes to cut off Luke's support, limiting his options and resources.
gameText: Deploy on table. I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee may not be played. After starting hands are drawn, to deploy a character for free (or 0 Force), opponent must first use X Force, where X = half that character's printed deploy cost (round up). (Immune to Alter.)

title: Sim Aloo
lore: Imperial council member. Senior political advisor to Emperor Palpatine. Never speaks. Like his master, shows remarkable patience and wisdom.
gameText: Agendas: law, rule. While at Conference Room, adds one [Dark Side Force]. While with another Imperial Council Member, adds one battle destiny. Immune to attrition < 4.

title: Something Special Planned For Them
lore: The high command of the Emperor's fleet is selected as much for loyalty and obedience as for martial skills. A wise admiral knows better than to question Palpatine.
gameText: Deploy on table. Once per game, if opponent just played an Interrupt, may stack it here. To play any new Interrupt of same name, players must first stack it here. May place this Effect in Lost Pile (place cards here in owners' Used Pile) to retrieve a starship. Immune to Alter.

title: 3,720 To 1
lore: What are the odds of having a Corellian, a Wookiee and a protocol droid together with an Alderaanian princess who happens to be the daughter of the Dark Lord of the Sith?
gameText: Deploy on table. Droids are destiny +1. Once per turn, may place the bottom 2 cards in Lost Pile out of play to deploy (from Lost Pile) Forced Servitude, a character weapon, a location, or an Effect that deploys on a location (without 'lose' in game text). (Immune to Alter.)

title: At Last We Are Getting Results

titleComponents.name: At Last We Are Getting Results

lore: First sign that your blockade is going well: the Queen's on the comlink.
gameText: If Invasion on table, deploy on table. Maul ignores objective deployment restrictions. Your [Presence] droids are defense value +2. Your starships are deploy -1. Immunity to attrition of opponent's cards is -3. Immune to Alter.

title: Aurra Sing
lore: Bounty hunter. Former student of the Force. After failing her Jedi training, Aurra became known for hunting down and killing Jedi Knights.
gameText: During opponent's activate phase, may relocate Aurra to same site as a Jedi. Once per game, during your move phase, may fire her weapon at a Jedi; hit target is lost. Immune to attrition < 4.

title: Blown Clear
lore: Vader was nearly killed when Han damaged his TIE fighter during a surprise attack in the Death Star trench.
gameText: Deploy on table. May place an Imperial Council Member here from hand. Once per turn, if an admiral or logistics agenda here, may subtract X from a starship's forfeit and immunity to attrition for remainder of turn, where X = total influence at Conference Room.

title: Bounty
lore: One of the most profitable occupations in the galaxy is hunting down and capturing wanted beings. The more notable the quarry, the more profitable the venture.
gameText: Deploy on a just captured character without a bounty. During your control phase, may transfer captive to a related prison (take this card into hand) to retrieve 4 Force. If released, place captive (and cards on them) in owner's Used Pile. Your Force drains are +1 here. (Immune to Control.)

title: Colonel Wullf Yularen
lore: Imperial Security Bureau (ISB) officer assigned to brief Tarkin. Also ordered to ensure absolute loyalty to the Emperor. Leader. Will stop at nothing to fulfill Emperor's will.
gameText: Imperial Council Member. Agendas: logistics. ISB Agents are forfeit +1. While at Conference Room with Sim Aloo, may use 1 Force to subtract 1 from an opponent's just drawn non-Epic Event destiny.

title: Coordinated Attack
lore: 'Stay in attack formation.'
gameText: USED: If you just hit a target with a non-lightsaber non-[Permanent Weapon] weapon, may place target (and all cards on it) in owner's Used Pile. LOST: Cancel Heroic (and any immunity to attrition) on a character or starship this turn.

title: Crush The Rebellion
lore: After dueling his son and seizing control of a city in the clouds, Vader resumed his quest to destroy the Alliance.
gameText: Deploy on table. May place an Imperial Council Member here from hand. Once per turn, if a general or logistics agenda here, may subtract X from the forfeit and immunity to attrition of a character at a site for remainder of turn, where X = total influence at Conference Room.

title: Dark Jedi Lightsaber
lore: Multifaceted jewels focus light into a deadly blade. Projects a meter-long beam of pure energy. A lightsaber is constructed personally by a Jedi as a part of training.
gameText: Deploy on Aurra Sing or Sidious. May add 1 to Force drain at an [Episode I] site where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Add number of Jedi present. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.

title: Daultay Dofine
lore: Neimoidian Trade Federation captain who gained his current position through political backstabbing and family connections. Not favored by Darth Sidious.
gameText: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Blockade Flagship is immune to attrition < 9. While piloting Blockade Flagship and your [Theed Palace] Admiral's Order on table, Blockade Flagship may not be targeted by weapons or have its power reduced. Once per game, may take Gunray or Haako into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Forced Servitude
lore: The Empire often uses droids for nefarious purposes. Imperials compel droids to do jobs that are repugnant to humans. An automaton has no ethical conscience.
gameText: Deploy on table. Your troopers are Heroic. Opponent's total weapon destiny targeting your Heroic cards is +2. When opponent is about to remove their last card from Life Force, you may first place all your troopers in Used Pile (last card must still be removed). (Immune to Alter.)

title: I'm Sorry
lore: 'I'm sorry, too.'
gameText: Deploy on table. Floating Refinery is suspended during opponent's turn. During your deploy phase, may deploy one Floating Refinery, a non-unique cloud sector, or an Obsidian squadron TIE from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your turn, if you control 2 cloud sectors with TIEs, opponent loses 1 Force. Immune to Alter.

title: Imperial Code Cylinder
lore: Imperial officers are issued coded cylinders which access computer information via Scomp links. Each cylinder is coded to the officer's own security clearance.
gameText: USED: Take Executor: Control Station, Homing Beacon, or Kessel into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. STARTING: If Conference Room on table, deploy Ord Mantell, Death Star: War Room, There Is No Try, and two always [Immune to Alter] Effects (except Endor Shield or You Cannot Hide Forever). Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.

title: Janus Greejatus
lore: Imperial council member. Very cruel at heart. Has lusted for power his entire life. Predictable and controllable.
gameText: Agendas: logistics, rule. Once per turn, if at Conference Room and you just drew a non-Epic Event destiny < your total Influence here, may use 2 Force to cancel and redraw that destiny or use 4 Force to add 2 to that destiny.

title: Laser Gate
lore: Security corridors are guarded by a grid of laser emplacements which can be activated upon demand to seal off sensitive areas from intrusion.
gameText: Deploy between two non-exterior Death Star sites. Unless aboard a Lift Tube, for opponent's character to pass opponent must first lose 1 Force. At adjacent sites: weapon destiny draws are -1, your Force generation may not be limited, and opponent's characters are deploy +2.

title: Maneuver Check
lore: 'Luke, at that speed will you be able to pull out in time?'
gameText: Deploy on table. Once per game, if Alderaan 'blown away,' may target a system; unless opponent has a capital (or [Episode I]) starship there, Objectives treat that system as a Subjugated planet. Starships may not move the turn they are deployed (or carried) to Death Star. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand
lore: Spy. Ordered to kill Luke Skywalker. Assumed the identity of a dancer named 'Arica' in order to sneak into Jabba's palace.
gameText: While Luke or Emperor on table, power +1 and she moves for free. Permanent weapon is •Mara Jade's Lightsaber (may target a character or creature for free; draw two destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value).

title: Obsidian 10
lore: Recalled to defend second Death Star during construction. Stationed aboard Thunderflare.
gameText: Heroic. May add 1 pilot. OS-72-10 deploys -2 aboard. When lost from Endor, a mobile system, or a sector, may place this starship (and cards aboard it) in owner's Used Pile.

title: Officer Evax
lore: This Imperial Intelligence leader has a proven track record for predicting Rebel fleet movements. His coordination of starship maneuvers has saved many vulnerable bases.
gameText: Imperial Council Member. Agenda: logistics. Once per turn, if at Conference Room, may target an opponent's starship on table with power < total influence here. Opponent must use +2 Force to move target (or initiate battle there) this turn.

title: Stinger
lore: Constructed by a secretive Surronian hive craftguild. Equipped with H2-1 hyperdrive system and emergency braking jets. Guri's personal starship. Gift from Prince Xizor.
gameText: May add 1 pilot. Guri deploys -3 aboard. While Guri piloting, during any control phase may draw top card of Reserve Deck (if Chewie or Leia on table, Force Pile instead) and immune to attrition < 5.

title: There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement
gameText: Deploy on Conference Room. Revolution is canceled here. You may not deploy aliens (except Mara Jade and bounty hunters), [Episode I] cards, or Luke? Luuuuke!. Emperor and your admirals, generals, and moffs are Imperial Council Members and influence +1. While present, each Imperial Council Member adds one [Dark Side Force]. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to take one Laser Gate, an Imperial Council Member, or a Political Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your cards may deploy to table from Political Effects. May place your canceled Political Effect in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)

title: You Want This, Don't You?
lore: 'I can feel the hate swelling in you now...'
gameText: If opponent just drew a card for destiny, deploy on table and stack that card face up here. Opponent may lose 3 Force to take card stacked here into hand; place this card in Used Pile. (Immune to Control.)

title: Abyss
lore: Careless abuse of the Force by a young Jedi trainee can have dire consequences. When hanging from the weather vane of Cloud City, Luke's balance was his only hope.
gameText: Plays on table. Substituted battle destinies do not count against battle destiny limits. If all your battle destinies were canceled (and not redrawn) use 1 for your total battle destiny instead. Once per game, may play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect.

title: AT-AT Deployment Platform
gameText: Dark: May deploy Biker Scout Gear here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While Biker Scout Gear is here, 'deploy for free' in its game text may be treated as 'deploy from Reserve Deck for free.' Light: Your characters may enter/exit here for 2 Force each. Unless you occupy, AT-AT's immunity to attrition is +1 (or immune to attrition if non-unique).
locationDarkSideGameText: May deploy Biker Scout Gear here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While Biker Scout Gear is here, 'deploy for free' in its game text may be treated as 'deploy from Reserve Deck for free.'
locationLightSideGameText: Your characters may enter/exit here for 2 Force each. Unless you occupy, AT-AT's immunity to attrition is +1 (or immune to attrition if non-unique).

title: Carida: ISB Training Academy
gameText: Light: Imperial Council Members are forfeit +2 here. Immune to Revolution. Dark: Once per game, if opponent just played an Interrupt with 'Rebel' in title, may stack it here.
locationDarkSideGameText: Once per game, if opponent just played an Interrupt with 'Rebel' in title, may stack it here.
locationLightSideGameText: Imperial Council Members are forfeit +2 here. Immune to Revolution.

title: ComScan Detection
lore: The Imperial Navy boasts the best communications network in the galaxy. Sophisticated control technology allows the Empire to dispatch armed forces without delay.
gameText: If two related unique (•) sites are on table, deploy the related system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Peek at a face down card on table (except a Hidden Base indicator). OR If a character or starship's power was just reduced, reset that card's power to its printed power for remainder of turn.

title: Coruscant: ISB Central Office
gameText: Light: Unless Blount present, Empire's Sinister Agents may not flip. Immune to Revolution. Dark: If your spy here, you may play non-[Virtual Set 8] Interrupts with 'advisor' in title for 1 Force.
locationDarkSideGameText: If your spy here, you may play non-[Virtual Set 8] Interrupts with 'advisor' in title for 1 Force.
locationLightSideGameText: Unless Blount present, Empire's Sinister Agents may not flip. Immune to Revolution.

title: Dungeon (Prison)
gameText: Dark: May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, or a Rebel Base. Whenever you imprison a captive (without a bounty) here, may retrieve 2 Force (once per captive). Light: If you control, instead of Force draining, may release one imprisoned captive here.
locationDarkSideGameText: May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, or a Rebel Base. Whenever you imprison a captive (without a bounty) here, may retrieve 2 Force (once per captive).
locationLightSideGameText: If you control, instead of Force draining, may release one imprisoned captive here.

title: ISB Sector Office
gameText: Dark: Your total weapon and battle destiny here is + X, where X = highest printed influence at Conference Room. At related sites, may apply the ability of one Imperial Council Member here toward drawing battle destiny. Light: May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth, Kashyyyk, Ralltiir or Yavin 4.
locationDarkSideGameText: Your total weapon and battle destiny here is + X, where X = highest printed influence at Conference Room. At related sites, may apply the ability of one Imperial Council Member here toward drawing battle destiny.
locationLightSideGameText: May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth, Kashyyyk, Ralltiir or Yavin 4.

title: Kessel: Spice Mines - Docking Bay
gameText: Light: Your docking bay transit from here requires 3 Force (free if your smuggler present). Dark: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force (free if your smuggler present).
locationDarkSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force (free if your smuggler present).
locationLightSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 3 Force (free if your smuggler present).

title: Kessel: Spice Mines - Extraction Facility
gameText: Light: If you occupy, may use 3 Force to place a 'spice' card out of play. Dark: During your control phase, may use 1 Force to place a 'spice' card in owner's Used Pile.
locationDarkSideGameText: During your control phase, may use 1 Force to place a 'spice' card in owner's Used Pile.
locationLightSideGameText: If you occupy, may use 3 Force to place a 'spice' card out of play.

title: Kessel: Spice Mines - Prison
gameText: Light: If you control, may release any captives imprisoned here (may retrieve 1 Force for each). Dark: Whenever a droid is imprisoned here, may retrieve 3 Force (once per captive).
locationDarkSideGameText: Whenever a droid is imprisoned here, may retrieve 3 Force (once per captive).
locationLightSideGameText: If you control, may release any captives imprisoned here (may retrieve 1 Force for each).

title: Quietly Observing
lore: Bounty hunters watch from the shadows.
gameText: Deploy on table. Once per game, may deploy Bluffs from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Bluffs gains [Light Side Force] and [Dark Side Force]. Once per battle, may deploy a bluff card (if it is a character or vehicle) as a react. To reveal a bluff card, opponent must first use X Force, where X = 4 - number of bluff cards. Immune to Alter.

title: Ralltiir: Imperial Supply Route
gameText: Light: If you control, opponent's Imperial Supply Route game text is canceled. Dark: Place all devices (and Effects) on your characters just lost from table in owner's Used Pile.
locationDarkSideGameText: Place all devices (and Effects) on your characters just lost from table in owner's Used Pile.
locationLightSideGameText: If you control, opponent's Imperial Supply Route game text is canceled.

title: Watch Your Back!
lore: 'Fighters above you, coming in!'
gameText: Deploy a Virtual Set 13 site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If opponent just modified your battle destiny draw, cancel and redraw it (and it may not be modified). OR If opponent just canceled your battle destiny draw, make that destiny = X instead, where X is the number of battlegrounds you occupy.

title: Accuser
lore: Modified for optimal crisis response time. Veteran crew experienced at monitoring shipping lanes and Imperial port traffic.
gameText: Deploy -3 if Death Star II on table. May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4 TIEs. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 2. Power and forfeit +1 for each Rebel starship here. Has ship-docking capability.

title: Admiral Ozzel
lore: Leader of the Emperor's Death Squadron assigned to hunt down and crush the Rebellion. As clumsy as he is stupid. Has just failed Darth Vader for the next-to-last time.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting a capital starship at a battleground system, in each battle a player's first battle destiny draw may not be canceled or reduced and if opponent canceled a just drawn battle destiny, they lose 1 Force.

title: After Her!
lore: 'This one's a decoy!'
gameText: Plays on table. Unless present at a site, [Reflections III] Leia's game text is canceled. Each Amidala stacked on a Political Effect is a senator. Once per game, may take [Virtual Set 3] Astromech Shortage into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Black 3
lore: TIE/ln fighter of pilot DS-61-3. Stylized image of Corellian slice-hound painted on inner hatch.
gameText: Heroic. May add 1 pilot. When this starship is targeted by Tallon Roll, 'Rebel' in its game text may be treated as '[Independent Starship]' or '[Republic]'. While DS-61-3 piloting, immune to attrition < 5.

title: Captain Yorr
lore: Former member of Imperial Demonstration Team. Flew test flights during development of various TIE prototypes. Jendon's wingman. Has scored 24 combat victories.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots (3 if piloting any starfighter). If your starship participating in a battle is about to be excluded (even if that starship may not participate in battle) or made lost by opponent, you may choose for it to be 'hit' instead.

title: Comlink
lore: Hand-held communication device. Military comlinks have scrambling and variable frequency programming for secure communication during battles or emergencies.
gameText: Deploy on an Imperial. While present at a battleground (or deployed on Emperor), Imperials lost from Life Force satisfy an additional 2 Force loss. If Luke deploys using your objective, he deploys to Vader's site (if possible). Once per game, may take Rise, My Friend into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Commander Nemet
lore: ogistics officer for the Avenger, member of the Line Branch of the Imperial Navy. Relays important scanner information to Captain Needa. Fiercely competitive.
gameText: Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting at a battleground system, your Force drains here may not be canceled. While piloting at a system with a 'probe' card, during your deploy phase (or if just forfeited), may be placed as a 'probe' card at any system.

title: Conquest
lore: One of the Imperial cruisers that chased the Millennium Falcon from Tatooine. It scanned the Falcon just before Han punched his starship to lightspeed.
gameText: May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4 TIEs. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Once per turn, may lose 1 Force to cancel an Interrupt targeting a starship here. Has ship-docking capability.

title: Death Star Gunner
lore: Most gunners in the Imperial Navy once aspired to be TIE pilots, but lacked sufficient skills to fly starfighters. A few were assigned to the Death Star to man the main artillery.
gameText: While on Death Star: cancels opponent's game text on your non-docking bay Death Star sites, your [A New Hope] Epic Event total is cumulatively +2, and during your deploy phase, may place this character in Used Pile to take a Superlaser into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Dominator
lore: Victory-class hull overhauled with powerful thrusters and latest hyperdrive technology. Engineered to support task forces combating Rebel starfighters.
gameText: Destiny +2 when drawn for destiny. May add 2 pilots, 4 passengers, and 2 TIEs. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. May reveal this starship from hand to place on Used Pile. Has ship-docking capability.

title: Grand Admiral Thrawn
gameText: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Your [Independent] starships are lost. Once per turn, if at a system of parsec > 6, may deploy a Dreadnaught here from under your Starting Effect. Once per turn, if opponent's alien at same or related location, may peek at opponent's hand.

title: I Can't Shake Him!
lore: 'You've picked one up... watch it!'
gameText: For remainder of turn, opponent must first use 1 Force to fire a weapon and opponent's starship weapon destiny draws are -1. OR During opponent's deploy phase, [download] an Imperial of ability < 3 (except an admiral) aboard your starship.

title: Much Anger In Him
lore: 'Adventure, heh. Excitement, heh. A Jedi craves not these things. You are reckless.'
gameText: Use 4 Force to deploy on opponent's non-droid, non-Jedi Master character (or 2 Force on a Rebel). Character's game text is canceled and they draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Opponent may lose three cards from hand (may not be reduced) to cancel this Effect.

title: Nothing Can Get Through Our Shield

titleComponents.name: Nothing Can Get Through Our Shield

gameText: Starships may not have their deploy costs reduced below their printed deploy costs. During battle, may place 3 Defensive Shields from under your Starting Effect out of play to make your starship immune to attrition this turn. At sites related to systems you occupy, your total battle destiny is +1.

title: Sith Fury
gameText: USED: If you just drew a character for destiny, take that card into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Once per game, use 4 Force to deploy a Dark Jedi from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Trade Federation Tactics
gameText: USED: For remainder of turn, if your starship is about to be hit (or lost), that action may instead affect your character aboard that starship. LOST: If your [Episode I] character is about to be hit (or lost), that action instead affects your other [Episode I] character present.

title: Warrant Officer M'Kae
lore: Hard-working Avenger signal officer. Coordinates and tests tractor beam operations. Apprises Executor of his ship's activities and relays orders from the flagship to his captain.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. If your starship is about to be lost, may place devices aboard in owner's Used Pile. Once per turn, may deploy a device that deploys on a starship from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per game, if just forfeited, may take the bottom card of your Lost Pile into hand.

title: Where Are Those Droidekas?!
gameText: Deploy on table. Scum And Villainy is canceled. Non-unique destroyer droids are deploy -1 and forfeit +1. While all your characters at sites are destroyer droids, opponent's characters are defense value -1 for each destroyer droid present. Immune to Alter.

title: Abyssin Ornament & Wounded Wookiee
gameText: USED: Creature attacks at pits are immune to At Peace and Yarna d'al' Gargan until end of your next turn. (Immune to Sense) OR Cancel an attempt to target a rancor with a character weapon. OR Use 1 Force (2 if a rancor on table) to deploy Nal Hutta from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. STARTING: If Great Pit Of Carkoon on table, deploy from Reserve Deck an Effect that is always [Immune to Alter] and choose to deploy from Reserve Deck: Rancor Pit and a rancor there, OR Power Of The Hutt and Sarlacc. Place this Interrupt in hand.

title: Arica
lore: Mara Jade posed as a dancer at Jabba's Palace in an attempt to complete her master's task and kill Luke. Musician. Spy. Unable to convince Jabba to take her on his skiff.
gameText: Power +1 on Tatooine. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Arica to Luke's location. During your control phase, if present at a battleground (and Luke is not), may retrieve 1 Force. Immune to Undercover and attrition < 4.

title: Bib Fortuna
lore: Twi'lek leader and majordomo of Jabba's palace. Succeeded Jabba's last majordomo, Naroon Cuthus. Plotting to kill Jabba.
gameText: Opponent's non-Jedi characters are deploy +1 to [Jabba's Palace] sites. Once during your control phase, you may place three cards from hand in Used Pile to reveal top card of Reserve Deck; if it is an alien, take it into hand.

title: Chokk
lore: Klatooinian bodyguard currently in the paid service of Jabba the Hutt. Chokk takes pride in his work, and he is very good at it.
gameText: Deploys -1 to Tatooine. While with your non-droid character, if a battle was just initiated here, may use 1 Force to place Chokk in Used Pile; Interrupts may not be played until the weapons segment ends.

title: Collateral Damage
lore: Blast vests and helmets with blast shields cannot protect Rebel soldiers from grenades, panel explosions and other combat hazards.
gameText: If you just initiated battle where you have at least two characters (one a trooper and the other a leader), add two battle destiny. Opponent takes no battle damagethis battle. OR Deploy one Dewback from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Cyclone 1
lore: Enclosed armored transport adapted for hot climates by replacing tertiary weapons systems with additional Sienar t23 heat dissipation units.
gameText: Power +1 for each Sandtrooper present. Permanent pilots provide total ability of 2. May add 7 passengers. Once per game, may deploy a vehicle site or vehicle weapon aboard from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4.

title: Danz Borin
lore: Cocky gunner and bounty hunter. Maintains a residence on Nar Shaddaa, the spaceport moon of the Hutt homeworld. To his companions' delight, he's nearly as good as he boasts.
gameText: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. May add 1 to Force drains at same Nal Hutta location. Danz is a matching pilot for any [Independent Starship] starship and while piloting one, may not draw more than one battle destiny here (your battle destinies here may not be canceled or modified by opponent).

title: Dark Reconnaissance
lore: On her assignment to kill Sharad Hett, Aurra used her patience and cunning to help track down the Jedi Master.
gameText: Deploy on opponent's location. Wherever you have two Mistryl, your Force drains are +1. 'Stolen' on Swilla Corey is treated as 'placed in owner's Used Pile' and it may target a weapon instead of a device. Your Force drains here cannot be modified or canceled by opponent.

title: Devastator
lore: Supported the devastating subjugation of Ralltiir. While under the command of Darth Vader, chased and captured the traitor Princess Leia Organa aboard the consular ship Tantive IV.
gameText: May add 6 pilots and 4 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. May follow an opponent's starship that just moved from same system (if within range). Immune to attrition < 4.

title: Dewback
lore: Protected by hard skin composed of tough armored scales. Frequently ridden by sandtroopers stationed in desert environments.
gameText: If just drawn for a non-lightsaber weapon destiny, opponent loses 1 Force. Deploys only to Tatooine. May add 1 'rider' (passenger). Ability = 1/4. During battle, may make a character here defense value -1.

title: Force Push
lore: A fully-trained Sith warrior has more weapons at his disposal than just a lightsaber.
gameText: During battle, use 2 Force to target your Dark Jedi and opponent's character of equal or lesser ability present. Both targets are excluded from battle. OR Exchange two cards from hand with any one card from Force Pile; reshuffle.

title: Gravel Storm
lore: Tatooine's twin suns cause turbulent storms that strike with little or no warning. Strong winds whip rocks through the air with enormous force.
gameText: Lose 1 Force to target a desert or non-interior Tatooine site. For remainder of turn, all immunity to attrition there is canceled.

title: Imperial Detainment
lore: 'There'll be no escape for the princess this time.'
gameText: Deploy on table. We Have A Prisoner is a Used Interrupt. TIEs are deploy +1 to Launch Bay. During your deploy phase, may deploy from Reserve Deck (or retrieve) one Besieged or a Launch Bay; reshuffle. Once per turn, when your Imperial captures a character, opponent loses 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Imperial Entanglements
gameText: Deploy Tatooine (with Devastator there) and a non-Jabba's Palace Tatooine battleground site. For remainder of game, you may not deploy systems, non-Imperial characters, non-Imperial starships, or Jabba's Palace sites. While this side up, once per turn, may deploy a Tatooine battleground site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Opponent loses no Force to Tatooine Occupation or your Force drains at Tatooine system. Flip this card if you control three Tatooine sites and opponent controls less than three Tatooine sites.

title: No One To Stop Us This Time

titleComponents.name: No One To Stop Us This Time

gameText: While this side up, wherever you have a trooper riding a dewback, add one battle destiny. [Virtual Set 2] Local Trouble may be played at exterior Tatooine sites. Once during your control phase, may peek at the top X cards of your Reserve Deck, where X = number of Tatooine locations you occupy; take one into hand and reshuffle. Opponent's characters require +1 Force to move from Tatooine sites using their landspeed. Flip this card if opponent controls more Tatooine sites than you.

title: Imperial Pilot
lore: Among the Empire's best pilots. Loyal and fearless. Use superior numbers to overwhelm opponents. Trained under combat conditions. Wear sealed, high-gravity flight suits.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. Matching pilot for TIE Avenger. While piloting a TIE: it is maneuver +2, it moves for free, and when this character is just lost, may use 1 Force to place her in Used Pile. Corvettes are deploy +1 here.

title: Knowledge And Defense
lore: 'A Jedi uses the Force for knowledge and defense, never for attack.'
gameText: Deploy on table with 12 cards from outside your deck face-down under here. Thrice per game, may play a Defensive Shield or deploy (at any time) [Virtual Set 11] Restricted Access from here (as if from hand). Players do not draw or activate using Thrown Back. Each time a player attempts to deploy or take a card for free (except their first time per game) they must first use 1 Force.

title: Let's Pass On That
lore: 'Uu a'kingsa riika pagh bagla bis kachata weenow con bantha poodoo.'
gameText: During opponent's control phase, your ferocious creature attacks. At end of turn, if that creature is at an unoccupied site and did not move, opponent loses 1 Force and you retrieve 1 Force. OR Use 3 Force to retrieve a creature.

title: Look Sir, Droids
lore: Trooper 1124, Davin Felth, discovered droid plating dropped by R2- D2 and C-3PO when exiting escape pod.
gameText: USED: Take into hand from Reserve Deck a non-[Droid with Presence], non-[Permanent Weapon] droid. OR Place a card from hand on Used Pile. STARTING: Deploy from Reserve Deck two Effects which are always immune to Alter. If you have only one location (with < 3 [Dark Side Force]) on table, may deploy from Reserve Deck Central Office or Mos Eisley. Place this interrupt in hand.

title: Maul's Sith Speeder
lore: Attain speeds of up to 600 kph. 3 meters long. Extremely difficult to control at high speeds. Dengar rode a similar swoop when injured in a race with Han at Agrilat.
gameText: May add Maul as driver. May deploy with Maul as a 'react'. During battle, Maul may disembark (place this vehicle in Used Pile) to cancel the immunity to attrition of a Jedi here. Immune to attrition.

title: No Bargain
lore: 'Zeet tu seet. Jabba no tuzindy honkabee.'
gameText: Deploy on your [Reflections II] Objective; 'Xizor' on it (and on Guri) is treated as 'Shada'. Non-[Lightsaber] alien females are Mistryl and Black Sun agents. You may not deploy cards with ability except Mistryl and [Independent] starships. Unique (*) Mistryl (except Kitik) are power +2. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Raider Craft
lore: Modified light freighter. Length 20 meters. Heavily armored for a landing craft. Has ion cannon mounts. Often carries speeder bikes for reconnaissance purposes.
gameText: May add 2 alien pilots, 4 passengers, and 1 vehicle. Any Mistryl or smuggler is a matching pilot (while aboard, adds at least 1 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise).

title: Sandtrooper
lore: Equipped for harsh, high-temperature environments. Primarily assigned to search-and-destroy missions, but sometimes beaks up local disputes or recover stolen droids.
gameText: Deploys only to Tatooine or any desert. Immune to Sandwhirl. Your desert locations are destiny = 4. While 'riding' a dewback, power +3 and may not be targeted by lightsabers.

title: Scout Mercenary
lore: Opportunists work with corrupt governments and Raithal casino operators. Keep the Empire informed of local Alliance activity, for a price.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots (3 if a speeder bike). During battle, unless Gall on table, may use 1 Force to fire a DH-17 blaster twice (for free), separately or combined. While piloting a vehicle, she may use its defense value and may not go missing (except from your card).

title: SD-17 Homing Missile
lore: Originally developed by smugglers and pirates as defense against starfighters. Adapted by the Empire to serve as onboard defense for slow moving bombers.
gameText: Deploy on Boba Fett, Jodo Kast, or your character with a Jet Pack. May place this weapon in Used Pile to target a character or vehicle using 2 Force. Draw destiny. Character lost if destiny -1 > defense value. Vehicle hit if destiny +2 > defense value.

title: Sebulba
lore: Bad tempered Dug from Pixelito. He was about to turn Jar Jar into orange goo, until Anakin intervened.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of any combat vehicle he pilots. Brisky Morning Munchen is canceled. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Once per turn, if any podrace total > 0, may take your just drawn destiny into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny.

title: Shada
lore: Female spy and thief.
gameText: May deploy Shada and [Virtual Set 15] No Bargain instead of Xizor with your [Reflections II] Objective. While that Effect on table, Force loss from your [Reflections II] Objective is +1 and, once per turn, may lose 1 Force to add a battle destiny anywhere. Immune to attrition < 4.

title: Sith Probe Droid
lore: Patrol droids utilized by the Sith. Each droid has several multispectral imaging devices and a communications package. Used by Maul to track down Amidala.
gameText: When drawn for destiny during a battle or duel involving a Dark Jedi, destiny +2. During your move phase, may use 2 Force to relocate a Dark Jedi (with any captives they are escorting) to same site; place this droid in Used Pile.

title: Stunning Leader
lore: Stormtroopers are trained to stun, not kill, priority targets in order to split enemy forces and hold the leaders for interrogation. Stun effects wear off, requiring efficient action.
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy (or retrieve) a Mistryl from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If your Mistryl present during battle, use 1 Force to reveal the top three cards of opponent's Reserve Deck. Add the destiny number of the highest-destiny male revealed (if any) to your total power. Replace revealed cards.

title: Tatooine: Mos Eisley
gameText: Dark: Once per turn, when a player's Landing Craft takes off or lands here, that player may retrieve 1 Force  Light: Immune to Revolution. If a stormtrooper here, you must first use 2 Force to deploy a weapon or device at same or adjacent site.
locationDarkSideGameText: Once per turn, when a player's Landing Craft takes off or lands here, that player may retrieve 1 Force
locationLightSideGameText: Immune to Revolution. If a stormtrooper here, you must first use 2 Force to deploy a weapon or device at same or adjacent site.

title: The Mandalorian
lore: Trade Federation.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May deploy Jet Pack on him for free from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. He moves using it for -1 Force. Permanent weapon is Dual Blasters (may lose 1 Force to target a Jedi; until end of turn, choose: target may not fire weapons OR target loses immunity to attrition).

title: Trained In The Jedi Arts
lore: While Qui-Gon spent years maintaining peace, Maul was sharpening his combat skills. Those years of training came to fruition in one fateful moment.
gameText: Deploy on table. Your lightsaber and [Maintenance] cards are lost. 'Vader' on your Interrupts may be treated as 'Maul or Mara Jade.' Wherever you have an Effect with 'skill' in its game text, your Force drains and battle destiny draws are +1. (Immune to Alter.)

title: An Enemy Of The Republic
gameText: Deploy on Sidious. While at Senate, if a battle was just initiated anywhere, opponent must relocate this card to their participating non-droid character; during battle here, your destiny draws may not be canceled. If that character is about to be captured, lost, or forfeit, relocate this card to Sidious.

title: Coruscant: Chancellor's Office
locationDarkSideGameText: Once per game, may deploy [Virtual Set 16] Sidious here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While a Dark Jedi present, Force drains and Force drain bonuses here may not be canceled.
locationLightSideGameText: Unless a Jedi present, Force drain -1 here. Immune to Revolution.

title: Coruscant Guard
lore: Coruscant Guards are an elite force whose assignments include the protection of important political figures, as well as the policing of Coruscant's higher profile city districts.
gameText: Heroic. Deploys -1 to Senate. While at Senate, Sidious is cumulatively Politics +2, and, during your control phase, may place this character in Used Pile to take [Virtual Block 5] Expand the Empire into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle, or take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.

title: Elite Squadron Stormtrooper
lore: Commander Igar selected the Empire's most dedicated stormtroopers to guard Endor for the Emperor. All they know is killing and white uniforms.
gameText: Clone. Heroic. Deploys -1 if a Dark Jedi at Senate. Power +2 if with Order 66. Jedi here are Heroic. Permanent weapon is blaster rifle (may target a character or vehicle for free; draw destiny; target hit if destiny > defense value).

title: Expand The Empire
gameText: Deploy on Senate. May raise your converted Senate to the top. Jedi here are politics +4. While your total politics here > 5, at battlegrounds where you have an Imperial, your Force drains and battle destiny draws are +1.

title: Keder The Black
gameText: While at Senate: Sidious is politics +3; 'senators' on Squabbling Delegates is treated as 'Coruscant guards;' and may lose 1 Force to place Keder and an opponent's [Coruscant] Political Effect (or [Coruscant] senator here) in owner's Lost Pile.

title: Lord Sidious
gameText: Whenever a Jedi is forfeited and you have exactly two Dark Jedi on table, retrieve 2 Force. While at your Senate and you have no senators here, Sidious is politics +4 and his game text may not be canceled. Immune to [Virtual Set 16] objective.

title: Nute Gunray's Bounty
gameText: Deploy on Amidala or opponent's senator. During your move phase, unless a Jedi here, your alien bounty hunter present may capture and seize that character. During your control phase, if that character is escorted by an alien, opponent loses 1 Force.

title: Order 66
